title: A2UI Decision Plan Benchmark Cases Schema
description: Schema for golden decision plan cases used to benchmark layout synthesis and backend accuracy.

name.description: Unique identifier for this decision case.

intent.description: User intent or instruction driving the UI synthesis.

payload.description: Structured JSON data payload passed to the decision synthesizer.

mutable_paths.description: Optional list of JSON pointer paths that are mutable.

expected.description: Expected synthesis outcomes for calibration and accuracy scoring.

family.description: Expected high-level UI family (e.g. monitor, browse, inspect, act, input, follow).

archetypes.description: Acceptable archetype names for this case.

required.description: Block IDs required in the synthesized layout plan.

forbidden.description: Block IDs that must not appear in the synthesized layout plan.

action_gate.description: Expected action gate behavior: pass means synthesized, abstain means blocked by action gate.

verified.description: Whether this case has been human-verified as a ground truth target.
